notes.title: Time Loader Demo is Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24679035/c7696494cf40e2586267c50d6561d21215668089.jpg[/img]
Hello, friends!

We know everyone’s hyped about the Steam Game Festival! And we totally get it: a gaming celebration where you get to try hundreds of different demos sounds super fun!

We are excited to announce that Time Loader is participating in the fest as well! And there’s more — we’ve released a small update for the demo. While it might look small, it changes the game quite drastically: our cute robot has got a brand new emotion display! We might be exaggerating a bit, but we are in love with this change and we’d like to invite everyone to see it as well!

Come to the game’s store page and check out the demo! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301950/Time_Loader/

Have fun, and stay safe!

notes.title: Come check Time Loader Prologue!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421970/Time_Loader_Prologue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24679035/1221b61def7b1a8c4bde29a753699bdf859da69d.jpg[/img][/url]
Hello friends!

We bet you already know that we, together with META Publishing, are working on a new project called Time Loader! It's a cool story-driven platformer with fun physics-based puzzles. What you might not know is that we just released a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421970/Time_Loader_Prologue/]prologue[/url] for the game that you're all welcome to try!!

[i]Time Loader is a story-driven, physics-based puzzle platformer with a twist. At the helm of a small robot, you'll travel back to the 90s to prevent a tragic accident. Explore the house of your creator, solve brain-teasing puzzles, acquire unique and powerful upgrades, and see common household items from an entirely new perspective![/i]

Doesn't it sound cool? This is our most ambitious project by far, and we are pouring our hearts and souls into it! We'll be delighted if you can give Time Loader a look and tell us what you think!

Have fun, and stay safe!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26500126/82f7d3af0adc13cfd302fa70794500269256c463.jpg[/img]
Hello fellows! Here is our new update.

What is new:
[list]
    [*] Camera distance improved.
    [*] Progress clearing fixed.
    [*] Screws counter bug fixed.
    [*] Achievement "motivation" is fixed.
    [*] Shadow for Canny in the sewers added. 
    [*] Cutscenes can be skipped with esc/start button. 
[/list]

We are still have some issues to work at. New update will be available soon. If you face some new problems let us know.
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26500126/6fc07230c9b1a2bdd5dc197451a6d9ff64284032.jpg[/img]Hello guys! We are really sorry that our release version was a little bit buggy! So thanks for your patience and your feedback. We have fixed the most annoying issues, that you have mentioned in reports.

What is fixed:
[list]
[*]Terminal (Robot Commander) interface bug fixed (you can now go back to the game with esc button).
[*]Falling trough the floor bug fixed.
[*]Screws collected on the first scene (house) are staying now.
[*]Some achievements are fixed.
[/list]

We are still here to support the game, so if you face some new bugs, don't hesitate to write us about it. 
Enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyː
